title: Auto-anatomist network
summary: The auto-anatomist's 3-D network: a residual U-Net, a plain U-Net or a probe, with its widths and groups.
does: The model spot of the auto-anatomist (vendored from bordercall on the unmerged pull request #483, grid/autoanatomist/autoanatomist/blocks.py there): residual-unet, plain-unet or probe, the encoders' channels at three scales (the key widths, default 16:32:64) and group norm's groups (default 8). It reads CT crops around each vertebra with the privileged mask channels its trainer anneals away. Nothing on main runs it.

outputs.name: model
outputs.what: The network, shaped by the crops it will read.

params.name: architecture
params.what: the network the model spot takes

params.name: width_1
params.what: the encoders' channels at the first scale (widths=a:b:c); 1024 is the sandbox's cap

params.name: width_2
params.what: the encoders' channels at the second scale; 1024 is the sandbox's cap

params.name: width_3
params.what: the encoders' channels at the third scale; 1024 is the sandbox's cap

params.name: groups
params.what: group norm's groups; 64 is the sandbox's cap

nondeterminism: The new head starts from a random draw made under its trainer's seed, so the network repeats only with that seed.

generic.why: It reads 3-D CT crops around each vertebra (#483); 2-D frames would need a 2-D U-Net and crops of their own.

today.note: Built on the unmerged pull request #483 (grid/autoanatomist/ on its branch); nothing on main runs it until that pull request merges.
